sloka: फल मूल अशनौ दांतौ तापसौ धर्म चारिणौ ।वसन्तौ दण्डकारण्ये किम् अर्थम् उपहिंसथ ॥३-२०-८॥
transliteration: phala mūla aśanau dāṁtau tāpasau dharma cāriṇau ।vasantau daṇḍakāraṇye kim artham upahiṁsatha ॥3-20-8॥

translations.english: Feeding on fruits and roots and following the righteous path, we are living in Dandaka forest like ascetics. Why are you torturing us?
